solutions.title: DFS indexes
solutions.strategy: Assign complete-tree indexes and remember the first index seen at each depth.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every tree node is visited once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack and per-depth first indexes scale with tree height.

solutions.title: Normalized BFS
solutions.strategy: Process each level with positional indexes normalized by that level's first index.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node enters and leaves the queue once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue stores one level at a time, where w is the maximum real node count on a level.
